simpleVillager.name: Simple Villager
simpleVillager.short: No special ability. Help the Village identify the Werewolves.
simpleVillager.detail: You have no special ability. Help the Village identify the Werewolves.

seer.name: Seer (Voyante)
seer.short: Each night, discover one player's exact role.
seer.detail: Every night, choose one player and discover their exact role.

witch.name: Witch (Sorcière)
witch.short: Use one save potion and one kill potion, each once.
witch.detail: You have two potions: one to save the Werewolves' victim and one to kill another player. Each can be used once.

hunter.name: Hunter (Chasseur)
hunter.short: When eliminated, choose another player to die with you.
hunter.detail: When eliminated, choose another player to die with you.

cupid.name: Cupid (Cupidon)
cupid.short: On the first night, choose two Lovers.
cupid.detail: On the first night, choose two Lovers. If one dies, the other dies too.

littleGirl.name: Little Girl (Petite Fille)
littleGirl.short: Secretly spy while the Werewolves are awake.
littleGirl.detail: You can secretly spy while the Werewolves are awake. If caught, you can become their victim.

protector.name: Protector (Salvateur)
protector.short: Protect one player each night; not the same player twice in a row.
protector.detail: Protect one player every night against the Werewolves. You cannot protect the same player two nights consecutively.

elder.name: Elder (Ancien)
elder.detail: You survive the first Werewolf attack. Under classic rules, if the Village eliminates you, the Village loses its special powers.

villageIdiot.name: Village Idiot (Idiot du Village)
villageIdiot.short: Survive a Village vote, but permanently lose your vote.
villageIdiot.detail: If eliminated by the Village vote, you survive but permanently lose the right to vote.

bearTamer.name: Bear Tamer (Montreur d'Ours)
bearTamer.short: The narrator says each morning whether your bear growls.
bearTamer.detail: Every morning, the narrator indicates whether your bear growls. It growls if a Werewolf is sitting next to you.

raven.name: Raven (Corbeau)
raven.short: Secretly give a player two additional votes for the next day.
raven.detail: Every night, secretly select a player who receives two additional votes against them the following day.

twoSisters.name: Two Sisters (Deux Sœurs)
twoSisters.short: Two players recognize each other on the first night.
twoSisters.detail: This role occupies two player cards. The two players recognize each other during the first night.

villageVillage.name: Village-Village (Villageois-Villageois)
villageVillage.short: Your Villager identity is publicly revealed; everyone knows you are innocent.
villageVillage.detail: You have a publicly revealed Villager identity. Everyone knows this player is innocent.

stutteringJudge.name: Stuttering Judge (Juge Bègue)
stutteringJudge.short: Secretly request a second Village vote once per game.
stutteringJudge.detail: You can secretly request a second Village vote once per game, without additional discussion.

devotedServant.name: Devoted Servant (Servante Dévouée)
devotedServant.short: When the Village votes someone out, take their role before it is revealed.
devotedServant.detail: When someone is eliminated by the Village vote, you can take their role before it is revealed.

colossus.name: Colossus (Colosse)
colossus.short: If Werewolves kill you at night, learn their identities and take one with you.
colossus.detail: If killed by the Werewolves at night, you discover their identities and choose one Werewolf to die with you.

geniusMonkey.name: Genius Monkey (Singe Savant)
geniusMonkey.short: Once per game, investigate players one by one; finding a Werewolf kills you.
geniusMonkey.detail: Once per game, investigate players one after another. If you discover a Werewolf, you die immediately. You can stop before finding one.

regularWerewolf.name: Regular Werewolf (Loup-Garou)
regularWerewolf.short: Wake with the other Werewolves and help choose a victim.
regularWerewolf.detail: You wake with the other Werewolves and participate in choosing a victim.

infectiousFather.name: Infectious Father of Wolves (Infect Père des Loups)
infectiousFather.short: Once per game, infect the Werewolves' victim instead of killing them.
infectiousFather.detail: Once per game, you can infect the Werewolves' victim instead of killing them, converting that player to the Werewolf side.

whiteWerewolf.name: White Werewolf (Loup Blanc)
whiteWerewolf.short: Pretend to cooperate; every other night you can kill a Werewolf.
whiteWerewolf.detail: You pretend to cooperate with the Werewolves, but every other night you can kill one of them. You want to be the last survivor.

angel.name: Angel (Ange)
angel.short: Win immediately if eliminated by the first Village vote.
angel.detail: You win immediately if eliminated by the first Village vote.

ankou.name: Ankou
ankou.short: After death, secretly vote from the graveyard for up to two Village votes.
ankou.detail: After dying, you can secretly vote from the graveyard for up to two Village votes.

wildChild.name: Wild Child (Enfant Sauvage)
wildChild.short: Choose a mentor on the first night; become a Werewolf if they die.
wildChild.detail: Choose a mentor on the first night. If the mentor dies, you become a Werewolf.

rebouteux.name: Rebouteux
rebouteux.short: Once per game, restore another player's used one-time profession ability.
rebouteux.detail: Once per game, restore an already-used, one-time building or profession ability belonging to another player.

barber.name: Barber (Barbier)
barber.short: Once by day, eliminate someone; survive only if they are a Werewolf.
barber.detail: On the first night, agree on a secret signal with the narrator. When you perform it during the day, the narrator wakes you alone after everyone else is asleep. Once per game during the day, you can eliminate someone. If the target is a Werewolf, you survive. Otherwise, you die.

shepherd.name: Shepherd (Berger)
shepherd.short: Send sheep each night to protect Villagers; a sheep sent to a Werewolf is eaten.
shepherd.detail: The narrator decides your number of sheep after role selection. Send them to players each night. A sheep protects a Villager from the Werewolves. If sent to a Werewolf, that Werewolf is eaten too. A consumed sheep is permanently lost.

alien.name: Alien
alien.short: Guess a player's exact role after a secret narrator signal.
alien.detail: You are an independent role. On the first night, agree on a secret signal with the narrator, similar to the Barber. When the narrator wakes you alone, choose a player and guess their exact role. If correct, the target dies. If wrong, you die.

maitreOurse.name: Maître Ourse
maitreOurse.short: Like the Bear Tamer, but choose a different seating position each night.
maitreOurse.detail: Like the Bear Tamer, but you can choose a different seating position each night. The narrator checks whether a Werewolf is next to the chosen position.
